details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price < 30 ORDER BY price;

details_finetuned.question: What is the average number of items per order?
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(item_count), 2) AS avg_items_per_order FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id);
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(quantity), 1) AS avg_items FROM order_items;

details_finetuned.question: Which product was ordered the most times (by order count, not quantity)?
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS n_orders FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY n_orders DESC LIMIT 1;
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity), 1) AS qty FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 1;

details_finetuned.question: What is the average price per category?
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY avg_price DESC;

details_finetuned.question: Label each product as 'cheap' (<$30), 'mid' ($30-$100), or 'expensive' (>$100).
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT name, price, CASE WHEN price < 30 THEN 'cheap'      WHEN price <= 100 THEN 'mid'      ELSE 'expensive' END AS price_tier FROM products ORDER BY price;
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT name, category, CASE WHEN price < 30 THEN 'cheap' WHEN price >= 30 AND price <= 100 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'expensive' END AS price_level FROM products ORDER BY price_level;

details_finetuned.question: Which product categories have an average price above $100?
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING avg_price > 100 ORDER BY avg_price DESC;
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT category, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING avg_price > 100 ORDER BY avg_price DESC;

details_finetuned.question: Show total inventory value per category.
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(price * stock_qty), 2) AS total_value FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_value DESC;
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) AS value FROM order_items GROUP BY category ORDER BY value DESC;

details_finetuned.question: What is the revenue from shipped orders?
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped';
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_status = 'shipped' ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

details_finetuned.question: How many customers are from Germany?
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany';
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany' ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;

details_finetuned.question: How many orders were cancelled?
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' ORDER BY n DESC;

details_finetuned.question: How many orders were placed each year?
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

details_finetuned.question: What is the total quantity sold across all orders?
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items;
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity), 1) AS total_sold FROM order_items oi;

details_finetuned.question: What is the most common order status?
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;

details_finetuned.question: Show the 5 most expensive products.
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;

details_finetuned.question: Which categories have more than 3 products?
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING n > 3 ORDER BY n DESC;
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING n > 3 ORDER BY n DESC;

details_finetuned.question: Find the highest-revenue single order.
details_finetuned.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;
details_finetuned.pred_sql: SELECT o.order_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;
